text: Bitcoin's 6% gain to $76,918 is outpacing Ethereum's 3.3% rise, pushing BTC dominance to 59.2% and suggesting investors are rotating toward perceived safety in the largest asset. The Fear & Greed index at 72 (greed) with a 43-point weekly climb reflects a sharp sentiment shift from caution to optimism, though Ethereum's lagging performance hints at selective risk appetite rather than broad euphoria. Volume of $159B supports the move but remains moderate relative to historically explosive rallies, indicating measured conviction rather than panic buying.
